display.title: Water, Hashem's Precious Gift: Why We Wash Negel Vasser
display.summary_short: Why water is one of Hashem's greatest gifts, and how its special power of purity is why we wash negel vasser every morning.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that life on earth depends on water, and that Hashem placed the sun over 93 million miles away, exactly far enough that the oceans neither boil nor freeze. We pray for rain and say a Shehakol before drinking water. Water also has a spiritual power to make us pure: the Kohen Gadol washed his hands and feet at the large brass basin at the entrance of the Mishkan, and so we begin each day by washing negel vasser, to serve Hashem in cleanliness and purity. The clip ends by introducing a story about Rabbi Akiva and this mitzvah, which is not included.
display.lesson: Appreciate Hashem's gift of water, and start every day by washing negel vasser so you serve Hashem in purity.
